expressions.meaningZhHant: 把商品或票券賣光；（商品或票券）售罄。

primaryExample.sentenceEn: They sell fresh fruit at the market.

expressions.meaningZhHant: 說服某人接受或喜歡某事物。

primaryExample.sentenceEn: She sold me on the idea of taking the train.
primaryExample.translationZhHant: 她說服我接受搭火車這個想法。
